title: Process a non-PO vendor invoice
purpose: Ensure non-PO invoices are validated and paid accurately, on terms, without late fees.
scope: All non-PO vendor invoices under $5,000 entered in NetSuite. Excludes PO-backed and intercompany invoices.
steps: Open the invoice in the NetSuite AP module.
Verify the vendor, amount, and remittance details against the invoice PDF.
Match the invoice to the receiving record.
If the amount exceeds $5,000, route to the AP manager for approval.
Post the invoice and schedule payment per the vendor's terms.
